Hi all —

We're running a short (30–40 minute) cross-company inference showcase next week to highlight practical latency/cost tradeoffs and quick integration patterns. Thought this would be a good way for engineering and platform folks at each company to compare notes and ask product-specific questions.

Quick details:
- Goal: 30–40 min demo + 10 min Q&A
- Focus: serving runtime optimizations, routing policies, and KV/prefix caching examples
- Capacity: limit to 6 external orgs to keep it interactive

Can you each pick preferred 2 times from the poll below? We'll pick the slot that fits the most people and send a calendar invite. If you'd like an engineer on the call, add a note in your reply and we'll loop them in.

Poll link: https://doodle.com/scheduling/rdw-inference-showcase (please answer by Friday EOD)

Attachments: lightning-showcase-agenda.pdf (1 page), demo-slide-deck.pdf (stub)

Thanks —
